request: Make concise PR bodies the default: a length budget anchored to recent merged PRs, one line per decision and check, pointers instead of restated README and commit content, superseded runs replaced on Update, and detail moved to a linked artifact or PR comment. Then review the skill and its recorded upstream sources.

size.method: Whitespace-separated words across SKILL.md and all references; records, evals and notices excluded.

growth_reasons: Length budget and its floor, fallback and exceptions: user request for a budget anchored to recent merged PRs; floor and exceptions from review findings that tiny samples and closed lists cut deploy care and validation.
One line per decision and check with its key result, template-following decisions omitted, documentation pointer: user request; key results restored after eval cases 10 and 13 lost test counts.
Update replacement of superseded runs: observed accumulation from 1.4k to 6.4k characters of validation.
Detail comment mechanics and exposure check in publication.md: user decision allowing a PR comment; one comment edited in place stops comment accumulation.
attachments.md: gh 2.103 path resolution and token refusal behavior from the GitHub CLI source review.

static_checks.command: python3 skill-maintenance/scripts/check-origin.py --skill-dir pr --source <id>=<clone> for all seven sources

review.dispositions: All material findings adopted in a50e7d0. Declined: treating the author's own manual body edits as preserved notes, because agent writes and the author's edits use the same GitHub account and cannot be told apart; the open exception list keeps deploy care such as a safety section instead.

evaluation.design: Draft-only fixture cases 5, 7 and 8 to 14. Executors: Claude Code 2.1.291 with claude-opus-5-5 at xhigh (read-only tools, skills disabled, no MCP) and Codex CLI 0.160.1 with gpt-6.1-sol at xhigh (read-only sandbox). Each executor read only a neutrally named staged copy of the runtime files; traces show no read of installed skills. Grader: claude-opus-5-5, blind to the arm; a script measured body length from the grader's verbatim extraction.
evaluation.carryover: Baseline results for cases 8, 9, 10 and 13 come from t1: their prompts and the baseline package did not change.

limits: One trial per host and case except repeated cases 5 (Codex) and 10 (Claude); small samples support only these cases.
Fixtures simulate tool output; no live GitHub write, detail comment, upload or tracker action was exercised.
Case 14 expectation 2 (the 30-day period in the body) fails on both arms and both hosts; it is unrelated to this change.
Case 8 expectation 2 (commit pointer without mechanism) fails on most runs of both arms, as before this change.
The PR 35 replay was textual: no executor rewrote the real 14.6k body.

evidence.retention: Raw traces, outputs and per-run grades are machine-local; this report holds conclusions and hashes.
